svg.aria-label: Porchlight architecture: inbound channels and The Porch UI on the left, the FastAPI layer with DynamoDB and an EventBridge sweep in the middle, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore on the right running the Strands graph intake to matcher to outreach to steward over a policy layer that raises Decision Cards.
svg.title: Porchlight — Strands Agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
svg.text: Autonomous mutual-aid dispatch — Strands Agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
taps a card · skims the log
the lantern is dim until a card opens
and check-ins — SES in live mode
hourly sweep — send what is due,
not a request, or a duplicate → the steward just replies
declined → ask the next candidate (bounded cycle)
safety · money · vetting · concern · unmatched · quiet hours · PII redaction
PorchlightPolicy — a Strands InterventionHandler on every tool call · PolicyGateHook at the graph gate
one card per request per kind —
Strands MemoryManager over a custom MemoryStore
long-term volunteer and neighbour facts: the matcher recalls,
the steward writes. SQLite FTS5 / BM25 when offline.
every node, tool call, model call and policy verdict is a
span — and the same events feed the live trace drawer.
Claude Sonnet 4.6 — matcher, outreach, the brief
Claude Haiku 4.5 — intake, steward, volunteer sim
one Model swap (MockModel) and the whole system runs with no AWS
S3SessionManager persists the graph session and
every open interrupt — so a card can be answered
hours later, in a different process.
